entities.description: A table with column headers for variable symbol, meaning, and remarks, as described by the column headers.
The first column header 变量符号 (Variable Symbol), representing the symbolic notation for variables in the table.
The second column header 含义 (Meaning), representing the definition or significance of the variables listed in the table.
The third column header 备注 (Remarks), representing additional notes or comments related to the variables in the table.
